title: HSK 2.11 · 教育, 习惯, 旅游, 练习, 自行车
focus: 画 · 广告 · 猫 · 排 · 鱼 · 教育 · 取 · 层 · 腿 · 全国 · 街 · 笔 · 鞋 · 习惯 · 国际 · 推 · 喂 · 流 · 实在 · 取得 · 实际 · 练 · 体育 · 旅行 · 旅游 · 教师 · 出租车 · 流行 · 懂得 · 广场 · 全体 · 全身 · 练习 · 自行车 · 笔记本 · 排队 · 球场 · 教学 · 全家
body:
School, travel and everyday objects. 全 whole, 教 teach, 行 go/travel and 练/习 practice keep coming back, and many single characters are 'radical + sound' (猫, 排, 推, 腿, 鞋).

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 全 | quán | whole, all | 全国, 全体, 全身, 全家 |
| 教 | jiào / jiāo | teaching / to teach | 教育, 教师, 教学 |
| 行 | xíng | to go, travel | 旅行, 流行, 自行车 |
| 习 | xí | to practice, be used to | 习惯, 练习 |
| 体 | tǐ | body (亻 + 本 root) | 体育, 全体 |
| 实 | shí | real, solid (宀 roof) | 实在, 实际 |
| 旅 | lǚ | travel | 旅行, 旅游 |
| 场 | chǎng | open space, field | 广场, 球场 |

## Watch out

- 推 tuī push vs 拉 lā pull: both have 扌 hand; check door signs.
- 喂 is wéi when answering the phone (喂？) and wèi for feeding.
- 教 is jiāo as a verb (教我中文) and jiào in nouns (教育, 教师, 教室).
- 体育 and 教育 share 育 yù (raise, nurture).

cards.Example: 我喜欢画画。 wǒ xǐhuan huàhuà: I like drawing
cards.Notes: A frame (凵) around 田 field: marking out boundaries, so to draw. 画画 = to draw pictures

cards.Example: 电视上广告太多了。 diànshì shang guǎnggào tài duō le: There are too many ads on TV
cards.Notes: 广 wide + 告 tell = tell widely, advertise

cards.Example: 我家有两只猫。 wǒ jiā yǒu liǎng zhī māo: We have two cats
cards.Notes: 犭 animal + 苗 miáo (sound) = cat

cards.Example: 我坐第一排。 wǒ zuò dì yī pái: I sit in the first row
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 非 fēi (sound) = to arrange in order, a row. 排队 line up

cards.Example: 我不吃鱼。 wǒ bù chī yú: I don't eat fish
cards.Notes: Picture of a fish: head on top, body, tail at the bottom. Radical in 鲜 fresh

cards.Example: 父母很重视教育。 fùmǔ hěn zhòngshì jiàoyù: Parents value education
cards.Notes: 教 teach + 育 raise, nurture = education

cards.Example: 我去银行取钱。 wǒ qù yínháng qǔ qián: I'm going to withdraw money
cards.Notes: 耳 ear + 又 hand: a hand taking an ear (ancient war trophy) = to take

cards.Example: 我住在三层。 wǒ zhù zài sān céng: I live on the third floor
cards.Notes: 尸 (roof-like cover) + 云; simplified from 層 (曾 céng, sound) = layer, floor

cards.Example: 我的腿很累。 wǒ de tuǐ hěn lèi: My legs are tired
cards.Notes: 月 body + 退 tuì (sound) = leg

cards.Example: 他在全国很有名。 tā zài quánguó hěn yǒumíng: He's famous nationwide
cards.Notes: 全 whole + 国 country = the whole country

cards.Example: 我们去街上走走。 wǒmen qù jiē shang zǒuzou: Let's take a walk in the street
cards.Notes: 行 crossroads split around 圭 guī (sound) = street

cards.Example: 借我一支笔。 jiè wǒ yì zhī bǐ: Lend me a pen
cards.Notes: ⺮ bamboo + 毛 hair = a brush: bamboo handle with hair tip

cards.Example: 这双鞋很好看。 zhè shuāng xié hěn hǎokàn: These shoes look nice
cards.Notes: 革 leather + 圭 guī (sound) = shoe

cards.Example: 我习惯早起。 wǒ xíguàn zǎo qǐ: I'm used to getting up early
cards.Notes: 习 practice + 惯 accustomed (忄 heart + 贯 guàn, sound) = practiced until used to

cards.Example: 这是国际学校。 zhè shì guójì xuéxiào: This is an international school
cards.Notes: 国 country + 际 boundary, between (阝) = between countries

cards.Example: 请推门。 qǐng tuī mén: Please push the door
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 隹 zhuī (sound) = to push. Opposite: 拉 lā pull

cards.Example: 喂，你好！ wéi, nǐ hǎo: Hello? (on the phone)
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 畏 wèi (sound). wéi on the phone; wèi to feed (喂猫)

cards.Example: 他流了很多汗。 tā liú le hěn duō hàn: He sweated a lot
cards.Notes: 氵 water + 㐬 liú (sound) = to flow. 流利 fluent, 流行 popular

cards.Example: 我实在太累了。 wǒ shízài tài lèi le: I'm really exhausted
cards.Notes: 实 real, solid + 在 exist = really

cards.Example: 他取得了好成绩。 tā qǔdé le hǎo chéngjì: He got good grades
cards.Notes: 取 take + 得 obtain = to gain, achieve

cards.Example: 这个想法不实际。 zhège xiǎngfǎ bù shíjì: This idea isn't realistic
cards.Notes: 实 real + 际 border, situation = actual circumstances

cards.Example: 我每天练字。 wǒ měitiān liàn zì: I practice handwriting daily
cards.Notes: 纟 silk + 东-like part (from 柬 jiǎn, sound): originally to boil silk soft. Lookalike: 炼 (火 fire)

cards.Example: 我喜欢上体育课。 wǒ xǐhuan shàng tǐyù kè: I like P.E. class
cards.Notes: 体 body + 育 nurture = physical education, sports

cards.Example: 我们去旅行吧。 wǒmen qù lǚxíng ba: Let's go on a trip
cards.Notes: 旅 travel + 行 go = to travel

cards.Example: 我想去北京旅游。 wǒ xiǎng qù Běijīng lǚyóu: I want to visit Beijing
cards.Notes: 旅 travel + 游 roam, swim (氵) = sightseeing, tourism

cards.Example: 她是一名教师。 tā shì yì míng jiàoshī: She's a teacher
cards.Notes: 教 teaching + 师 master = teacher (more formal than 老师)

cards.Example: 我们打出租车吧。 wǒmen dǎ chūzūchē ba: Let's take a taxi
cards.Notes: 出租 rent out (出 out + 租 rent) + 车 car = car for hire

cards.Example: 这首歌很流行。 zhè shǒu gē hěn liúxíng: This song is popular
cards.Notes: 流 flow + 行 go = flowing around, spreading: popular

cards.Example: 他懂得很多。 tā dǒngde hěn duō: He knows a lot
cards.Notes: 懂 understand + 得 get = to grasp, understand

cards.Example: 我们在广场见。 wǒmen zài guǎngchǎng jiàn: Let's meet at the square
cards.Notes: 广 wide + 场 open space = a wide open place, square

cards.Example: 全体学生都来了。 quántǐ xuésheng dōu lái le: All the students came
cards.Notes: 全 whole + 体 body = the whole body (of people)

cards.Example: 我全身都疼。 wǒ quánshēn dōu téng: My whole body aches
cards.Notes: 全 whole + 身 body = whole body

cards.Example: 多练习就好了。 duō liànxí jiù hǎo le: Just practice more
cards.Notes: 练 train + 习 practice = practice

cards.Example: 我骑自行车上学。 wǒ qí zìxíngchē shàngxué: I bike to school
cards.Notes: 自 self + 行 go + 车 vehicle = a vehicle that goes by itself (you power it)

cards.Example: 我买了一个笔记本。 wǒ mǎi le yí ge bǐjìběn: I bought a notebook
cards.Notes: 笔 pen + 记 record + 本 book = a book for notes; also a laptop

cards.Example: 请排队。 qǐng páiduì: Please line up
cards.Notes: 排 arrange in a row + 队 line = to queue

cards.Example: 我们在球场踢球。 wǒmen zài qiúchǎng tī qiú: We play soccer on the field
cards.Notes: 球 ball + 场 field = sports ground

cards.Example: 他的教学很好。 tā de jiàoxué hěn hǎo: He teaches well
cards.Notes: 教 teach + 学 learn = teaching and learning. Also jiāoxué (to teach)

cards.Example: 我们全家去旅游。 wǒmen quánjiā qù lǚyóu: Our whole family went traveling
cards.Notes: 全 whole + 家 family = the whole family
